_comment: `define` inserts `early()` before the declaration of `early`, and `late()` after the declaration of `late`. The inserted reads have an empty span at 0, so only the AST order tells them apart. `last`, an annotated declaration after `LATE`, makes the check visit `LATE`. The calls of `early` and `coalesced` must stay and throw, because `null` makes the right operand of `??` run. In define-annotation.js, `define` gives `fromDefine` its `@__NO_SIDE_EFFECTS__` annotation, so the source of that module has no annotated binding before Step 2. The call of `fromDefine` before its declaration must stay and throw. The call of `late` should be removed.
